blocks.title: Communication
blocks.text: Communication maloomat, khayalat ya jazbat ka tabadla hai, zabani (bolna ya likhna) ya ghair zabani (ishare, chehre ke taasurat). Achhi communication paigham wazeh pohanchati aur tawajjo se sunna shamil karti hai.

items: Wazeh bolna: sab ke liye aasani se samajh aaye.
Achhi body language: ishare, aankh se rabta aur pur-aitmaad andaaz.
Sunna: sameen ke sawalon ke jawab aur raye par ghaur.

blocks.prompt: Mahaul ke tahaffuz par class presentation mein ek zabani aur ek ghair zabani maharat bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Zabani: munasib raftar se wazeh bolna. Ghair zabani: sameen se aankh ka rabta rakhna.

items: Communication: wazeh bolna, body language, sunna.
